title: PR8490 verified URL and environment scoped backend credentials

phases.objective: Ensure API keys for Windows Staging and Hostinger Production remain separated by a credential-free exact URL and environment preflight, with no changed secret, runtime deploy or capability promotion.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Verify Runtime manual workflow dispatch with explicit environment_label and runtime_base_url
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A mismatched runtime URL and environment are rejected before accessing secrets; an approved Staging verification retains Repository key and an approved Production verification binds only Environment Production; redirects of authenticated GET and POST are not followed; live staging certification is still required.
steps: Bind target to the canonical staging or production hostname and reject arbitrary endpoints before any secret is exposed.
Keep the existing Windows Staging Repository BACKEND_API_KEY unchanged and never require any token prefix.
Bind the Production verifier job to GitHub Environment Production with deployment disabled.
Disable automatic HTTP redirects for authenticated GET and POST verification requests.
Preserve the live Staging certification requirement and deny Production promotion and any secret mutation.
assertions: The only accepted pairs are staging|https://dev.mad4b.com and production|https://auth.mad4b.com.
Rejected pairs never enter an authenticated verification job.
Staging Repository secret remains unchanged; Production Environment has its own secret.
Authenticated GET and POST reject automatic redirects.
No secret is printed, copied to job output, or mutated.
Live Staging certification remains required and Production mutation is not authorized.
